blocks.text: Bacteria aur archaea prokaryotic cells se bane hain, jabke baqi tamam jandar eukaryotic cells se bane hain. Prokaryotic aur eukaryotic dono cells ka genetic material DNA hai; dono ke gird plasma membrane ka ghilaf (covering) hai; aur dono mein protein banane ke liye ribosomes hain. Cell organelles ki tafseel aap parh chuke hain.

blocks.alt: Rod shakal ka prokaryotic cell: bahar capsule, cell wall aur plasma membrane cytoplasm ko gherte hain, jis mein nucleoid (DNA), plasmid aur bikhre hue ribosomes hain. Satah se chhote pili nikalte hain aur ek sire se lamba flagellum.

blocks.long_description: Labels: Capsule, Cell wall, Plasma membrane, Pili, Plasmid, Cytoplasm, Nucleoid (DNA), Ribosomes, Flagellum.

blocks.text: Prokaryotic cells eukaryotic cells se bohat saada (simple) hain. Zyada tar prokaryotic cells 2 se 8 µm lambe hote hain, yani aam eukaryotic cell ke size ka taqreeban daswan (one-tenth) hissa. Prokaryotic cell mein nucleus nahi hota. Is ka bohat kam DNA cell ke taqreeban darmiyani hisse mein hota hai jise nucleoid (nucleus jaisa) kehte hain.

Prokaryotic cell mein doosre membrane wale organelles bhi nahi hote, jaise endoplasmic reticulum, mitochondria, chloroplasts, Golgi apparatus, lysosomes, peroxisomes waghera. Prokaryotic cell ka poora cytoplasm ek hi hissa hai jis mein andar sahara dene wali koi structure nahi. Prokaryotic cell mein ribosomes hote hain, lekin eukaryotic cells ke ribosomes se chhote.

Prokaryotic ribosomes ke chhote aur bare subunits ki Svedberg values (centrifuge mein neeche baithne ki raftaar) 30S aur 50S hain, aur poora ribosome 70S hai. Zyada tar prokaryotic cells ki plasma membrane ke gird cell wall hoti hai, lekin us mein cellulose nahi hota. Yeh peptidoglycan se bani hai, jo amino acids aur sugar ka ek bara polymer hai. Bacteria mein cell wall ke gird capsule (bahari ghilaf) bhi ho sakta hai, aur chipakne ke liye bal jaise ubhaar bhi jinhen pili (wahid: pilus) kehte hain. Prokaryotic flagella protein flagellin ke baar baar dohraye units se bane hain aur un mein microtubule triplets nahi hote. Prokaryotic cell mein mitosis aur meiosis nahi hote; yeh seedhi taqseem (direct division, binary fission) se do cells ban jata hai.

blocks.text: Kitab ke table mein size ki unit "um" chhapi hai; sahi unit µm (micrometre) hai.

blocks.alt: Prokaryote (baen): bacterium jis ka flagellum ghoomta (spins) hai; bari tasveer mein flagellum ka filament, hook aur cell membrane mein laga ghoomne wala base. Eukaryote (daen): cell jis ka flagellum lehrata (waves) hai; bari tasveer mein cell membrane ke andar chalti microtubules, aur flagellum ki qash mein microtubules ki 9 + 2 tarteeb.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Prokaryotic flagellum ghoomta (spin karta) hai, jaise propeller; yeh flagellin protein ka khokhla dhaga hai jo membrane mein lage motor (base) se ghoomta hai aur membrane mein band nahi. Eukaryotic flagellum lehrata (wave karta) hai; is ke andar 9 + 2 microtubules hain aur yeh plasma membrane mein band hai.

blocks.prompt: Teen khususiyat batayen jo mitochondria prokaryotic cells ke saath share karte hain, aur teen tareeqe jin mein prokaryotic cell eukaryotic cell se mukhtalif hai.
blocks.explanation: Mitochondria aur prokaryotes dono mein circular DNA, 70S ribosomes hain aur dono taqseem se azaad replicate kar sakte hain. Prokaryotic cell mein nucleus nahin (nucleoid hai), membrane mein band organelles nahin (ER, mitochondria, Golgi, lysosomes nahin), chhote 70S ribosomes, peptidoglycan wall, flagellin ke flagella, aur yeh mitosis ya meiosis ki bajaye binary fission se taqseem hota hai; yeh taqreeban das guna chhota bhi hai.

items: Dono cell qismon mein DNA, plasma membrane aur ribosomes hain; prokaryotes (bacteria, archaea) 1-10 µm, eukaryotes 10-100 µm.
Prokaryotes: nucleus ki jagah nucleoid, plasmids, membrane mein band organelles nahin, 70S ribosomes (30S + 50S), peptidoglycan wall, capsule aur pili, flagellin ke flagella, binary fission.
Eukaryotes: bohat se chromosomes wala sahi nucleus, ER, Golgi, mitochondria, lysosomes, peroxisomes, cytoskeleton, 80S ribosomes, microtubule wale flagella, mitosis aur meiosis.
